# Stephanie
Williams-Rogers
for Brentwood City Council, District 4
## Experience serving Brentwood. Ready to deliver.
I’m running for City Council District 4 to help keep Brentwood safe and financially strong, bring more jobs closer to home, and make sure growth and infrastructure keep pace with our community’s needs.
Meet Stephanie
Meet Stephanie
priorities
priorities
### MY RECORD
## I’ve been trusted to serve. Here’s what I’ve done with that trust.
### PARKS & RECREATION
Expanded opportunities
Advocated for inclusive recreation, stronger youth opportunities, and practical improvements to Brentwood’s parks and recreation programs
### BRENTWOOD SCHOOLS
Led with accountability
Helped protect the district’s financial strength, plan for growth and a new school, and keep student safety front and center
### COMMUNITY LEADERSHIP
Served beyond Brentwood
Represented East County families, advocated for women and girls, and co-founded Miles for Mayo that gives back to local schools
SEE MY FULL RECORD
PRIORITIES
## A Voice for Brentwood’s Future
Growth That Makes Sense for Brentwood
As Brentwood approaches buildout, the decisions we make matter even more. We need to be intentional about future development and make sure our infrastructure and services keep pace with our community’s needs.
Safe Neighborhoods
Brentwood is a safe community and a great place to raise a family. I’ll work to make sure public safety keeps pace with our community and stays responsive to the concerns residents experience every day.
A Stronger Local Economy
More residents should have the opportunity to work closer to home. That means attracting quality employers, supporting local businesses, and building on Brentwood’s strengths and heritage.
A City That Works for Residents
Residents deserve steady leadership and a local government focused on the fundamentals: reliable city services, responsible management of public dollars, and accountability for getting work done
EXPLORE MY PRIORITIES
## Brentwood’s next chapter needs steady leadership.
I’ve spent years serving Brentwood, listening to residents and working through difficult issues. I’m ready to bring that experience, sound judgment, and a focus on results to the City Council.
There’s important work ahead. Let’s get to it.
